10k.note: 10-K describes ambulatory cardiac monitoring service (Zio long-term continuous monitoring patches plus AI-driven ECG analysis software / Zio ECG Utilization Service). No therapeutic drug pipeline.

website.error: no public drug-pipeline page; irhythmtech.com is product-marketing focused (Zio monitor service for clinicians)

ctgov.note: ctgov fetch returned 7 raw trials matching iRhythm but none classified as P1-P3 interventional with iRhythm as lead sponsor; iRhythm-sponsored studies are typically real-world evidence or device-validation observational studies.

commercial_product.note: Provider of ambulatory cardiac monitoring services. Marketed devices/services include the Zio long-term continuous monitor (Zio XT, Zio AT extended-wear ECG patches), Zio Monitor, and the Zio ECG Utilization Service (cloud-based AI ECG analysis with curated reports). FDA cleared via 510(k) pathway (multiple Zio generations).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: iRhythm is a cardiac-monitoring device and digital-health services company. Its commercial offering (Zio patches and ECG-analysis cloud service) is regulated as a medical device, and its clinical-evidence program is mostly real-world-evidence observational research rather than P1-P3 drug or device pivotals. No active company-sponsored P1-P3 interventional trial of a proprietary therapeutic asset.
